integrity: Standalone analytic proof with finite independent computation checks; no independent audit or literature-wide priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Finite simple undirected graphs, uniform positive ferromagnetic edge coupling, zero field, 0<s<1, and the strong-dephasing classical population generator only. Does not treat finite dephasing, weighted/directed graphs, external fields or non-asynchronous protocols; no quantitative entropy-production lower bound.
title: Complete-graph-or-cycle criterion for equilibrium in a nonlinear spin-flip sampler
